question: Council Recommendation of 15 March 2018 establishes a European framework for quality and effective apprenticeships, including requirements regarding the working conditions and health and safety of apprentices.

However, as it is non-binding and does not set out any harmonised monitoring requirements, disparities remain in the prevention and treatment of violence, harassment and discrimination experienced in training or at companies.

In France, Decree No 2026-728 of 1 August 2026 tightens, in particular, the obligations of training bodies with regard to the provision of information to apprentices, the handling of complaints and cooperation with the labour inspectorate. These mechanisms should provide a common basis for protection that is not limited to national measures. Can the Commission say: 1.

whether it is considering bolstering the European quality assurance framework for training, including the European Quality Assurance Reference Framework for Vocational Education and Training, by including common requirements for prevention, reporting and cooperation with national labour inspectorates?
whether it intends to make EU funding for apprenticeships more conditional on the effective application and monitoring of those safeguards?
